marketing_contact_lede: No forms, no queues. Questions, bugs, and ideas all land in the same place.
marketing_contact_reason_broken_detail: Include what you expected and what happened instead. Fixes land fast.
marketing_contact_reason_feedback_detail: The experience is the product. If something feels ordinary, that is worth an email.
marketing_contact_reason_questions_detai: Whether it fits your stack, how a feature works, or what is coming next. Ask anything.
marketing_contact_seo_description: Questions, bugs, and ideas: one email reaches the engineer.
marketing_content_ai_description: Draft and rewrite copy, take editorial suggestions, or delegate a whole task to an agent in the session.
marketing_content_analytics_description: See how every page performs, annotated with the context that explains why. Cookieless, with no consent banner.
marketing_content_collab_description: Realtime collaboration with live cursors, and comments that live on the content itself.
marketing_content_editor_description: Fast, calm, and beautiful, in a workspace shared by the whole team.
marketing_content_editor_name: An editor you want to write in
marketing_content_locales_description: Localized content built in: per-locale entries, translation status, and AI translation.
marketing_content_model_description: Collections and maps with fields, bodies, and validation, designed the way you think about content. No ticket, no wait.
marketing_content_publish_description: Drafts, scheduled publishing, version history, and rollback. Publish when it is ready, undo it when it is not.
marketing_content_review_description: Roles and publish permissions per collection, so the right people sign off before anything ships.
marketing_cta_body: Sign up and model your first collection, or follow {brandName} being built in the open. Questions and ideas are welcome any time.
marketing_eng_analytics_detail: Content served through the client reports its own performance, and typed events route through your own infrastructure, immune to ad blockers.
marketing_eng_api_detail: A REST API and drop-in components when you want them, and a CLI for scripting, seeding, and CI.
marketing_eng_api_term: REST API, SDKs, and a CLI
marketing_eng_client_detail: The Vite plugin generates a typed client from your project's content model and keeps it current as the model evolves.
marketing_eng_client_term: A client generated from the model
marketing_eng_deprecations_detail: A deleted field becomes a deprecation in the client, not a failed build or a broken page. Each team migrates on its own schedule.
marketing_eng_drafts_detail: Drafts and published entries are separate, typed views, served to your own app through the same client.
marketing_eng_webhooks_detail: Trigger rebuilds and syncs the moment content changes.
marketing_engineers_body: The content model marketing designs becomes an API your editor autocompletes.
marketing_footer_tagline: {description}. Marketing owns the model, engineering gets a typed contract, and nothing breaks between them.
marketing_hero_lede: Every CMS makes one side compromise. Developer-first tools bury content teams in JSON; marketer-first tools hand engineers an untyped API. {brandName} refuses the trade-off: marketing owns the content model, engineering gets a typed client generated from it, and nothing breaks between them.
marketing_landing_description: The CMS that refuses the marketing-vs-engineering trade-off: marketing owns the content model, engineering gets a typed client generated from it, and nothing breaks between them.
